reasoning_traces.think:
The core operators are grounded in geometric trigonometry and signal processing. The knee angle is computed using the cosine law, which assumes Euclidean geometry of limb segments. The repetition counting uses a thresholded peak detection mechanism that relies on signal normalization and temporal spacing. These operations are mathematically well-defined but critically dependent on the quality of input landmarks. The privacy claim is a weak cryptographic assertion without formal analysis. Failure modes include landmark misalignment, noise in angle signals, and overfitting to a single subject’s motion. The system lacks generalizability due to N=1 dataset and no clinical validation. The pipeline is a narrow technical solution rather than a scalable infrastructure component.
